requisitionList.Title: Sr. Infotainment Component Engineer - Compute and Connectivity
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
As a Sr Infotainment Component Engineer, you will be the Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for Ford’s High-Performance Computing Cluster (HPCC) and Telematics Control Unit (TCU) across their complete vehicle lifecycle.  
You will lead a broad technical community spanning systems engineering, software, electrical hardware, validation, manufacturing, service, cybersecurity, quality, program management, and suppliers. Success requires the ability to understand system behavior, identify integration risk early, and drive issues to durable resolution.
